days.intro: New freelancers sign up every minute. Each one gets a welcome kit. Let's make their first week easy.
Courier orders are for people mid-onboarding. If their kit is late, they drop off. Keep them moving.
Card readers and mugs break in the post. Wrap them first, so nobody's first impression is broken.
The bank link keeps timing out and stopping the belt. Pull the lever. And we have two Gold Cards!
Tax season. Every freelancer needs their kit at once. Calm, tidy, and quick.
